results.title: Developmental chronology of mouse embryo from 2-cell stage through birth
results.reason: This paper presents a comprehensive single-cell atlas of mouse development from 2-cell stage to birth, covering 37 time points and 2.2 million cells. The multi-batch, multi-time-point design with overlapping cell types across stages makes it highly suitable for integration benchmarking. results.methods_summary: Single-cell RNA-seq using 10x Chromium v3 on fresh cells from 351 embryos across 37 time points (E1.5 to E19.0). Cells were dissected, dissociated, and sequenced with >90% viability. After quality control, 2,230,900 cells were annotated into 6 major groups and detailed subtypes using transcriptomic signatures and literature markers. Integration with external datasets was performed using the Harmony algorithm.

Deep learning models (ChromBPNet) trained to predict base-resolution accessibility from local DNA sequence. Abstract: Human physiology and pathology arise from the coordinated interactions of diverse single cells.
